description: This line plot illustrates the performance of two large language models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, measured by their Accuracy@1 (%) as a function of the number of child nodes, or tree width, ranging from 1 to 7. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)", uses a linear scale with integer tick marks at 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", also uses a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at 20, 25, 30, and 35. The GPT-4o model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at 24.4% accuracy at a tree width of 1, rising to a peak of 34.4% at a tree width of 5, and then declining to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model is represented by a dashed light blue line with circular markers, starting at 26.7% accuracy at a tree width of 1, rising to 27.8% at a tree width of 3, then declining to 24.4% at a tree width of 5, and further decreasing to 20.0% at a tree width of 7.
